design.adapter: Expose client-only init, createRun, loadRun, saveTransition, deleteRun, migrate, and close operations using parameterized SQL, short transactions, event idempotency, version checks, busy retry, and typed unavailable/quota/corrupt errors.
design.client: Hydrate on startup, checkpoint after accepted transitions, show persistence status, preserve in-memory operation on failure, and reset/delete explicitly. No export/import, server, or network path.
design.compatibility: Feature-detect OPFS and SQLite WASM; document browser limitations and retain in-memory fallback. No Cloudflare configuration or server runtime changes.
design.orchestrator: The local orchestrator loads persisted task/invocation records through the adapter, recomputes aggregate progress from eligible logical task leaves, and writes state transitions transactionally. Attempts and telemetry never add completion credit.
design.storage: One browser-local SQLite WASM database on OPFS with schema_meta, runs, tasks, skill_invocations, attempts, and telemetry_events. Store schema_version, run/version fields, logical IDs, and timestamps.
